leaveWarning.title: Roster sheet is unlocked
leaveWarning.body: The Duty Roster has drag rearrangements that aren't locked in yet. Lock the roster or discard these changes before leaving.

login.title: Customer Relationship Management Portal
login.signInSubtitle: Sign in with your team account
login.signInError: Could not sign in. Check your email and password and try again.
login.resetSent: If an account exists for <bold>{{email}}</bold>, a password reset link has been sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
login.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address first.
login.footer: Accounts are created by your HQ admin. Contact them if you need access.

pipeline.title: Sales Funnel Pipeline
pipeline.contractEndingSoonSub: Qualified leads' current contract ends within {{days}} days
pipeline.disqualifyConfirm: Disqualify "{{name}}"? It will move straight to Disqualified Lead — this can only be undone by using its "Re-qualify" button.
pipeline.requalifyConfirm: Re-qualify "{{name}}"? It will move back to New Lead and re-enter the pipeline from the top.
pipeline.confirmMoveTerminal: "{{name}}" is already marked {{stage}}. Are you sure you want to move it to {{newStage}}?

submissionDateModal.title: Submission Date Required
submissionDateModal.body: "{{name}}" is moving to <bold>Submitted</bold>. Enter the date it was submitted to the client — once saved, only an Admin can change it.
submissionDateModal.expiryRequiredNote: Required for a Private tender — when the quote/tender validity to this client expires.
submissionDateModal.expiryOptionalNote: Optional for a Government tender — when the quote/tender validity to this client expires, if known.
submissionDateModal.errorFutureDate: Submission date cannot be a future date.
submissionDateModal.errorExpiryRequired: Please enter the submission expiry date — required for a Private tender.

tenderForm.categoryHint: A Private tender requires a submission expiry date once it reaches Submitted — a Government one leaves that optional.
tenderForm.departmentHint: Set automatically from the tender owner.
tenderForm.currentContractEndHint: When this lead's CURRENT awarded contract (with another provider, or an existing one of ours) is due to end — if known. Flagged on the Sales Funnel Pipeline's "Contract ending soon" reminder tile once within 30 days.
tenderForm.closedDateHint: Use the real date this tender was {{outcome}} — this is what the pipeline value trend chart uses, so it's safe to backdate for past deals.
tenderForm.disqualifiedHint: Set automatically when this lead was disqualified. Stage can't be changed from here — use "Re-qualify" below (or its card in the Sales Funnel Pipeline) to send it back to New Lead instead.
tenderForm.submissionDateLockedHint: Locked after first entry — ask your Admin if this needs to change.
tenderForm.submissionDateAdminHint: Already set — as Admin you can correct it if needed.
tenderForm.submissionDateFirstHint: The date this tender was submitted to the client — can't be a future date, and can only be entered once.
tenderForm.expiryRequiredHint2: Required for a Private tender — freely correctable any time, unlike Submission Date.
tenderForm.expiryOptionalHint2: Optional for a Government tender — freely correctable any time.
tenderForm.reassignConfirm: Reassign "{{client}}" from {{from}} to {{to}}? This also moves it to {{to}}'s department, and they'll be able to see and nurture it through the pipeline from here on.
tenderForm.errorSelectCategory: Please select whether this is a Government or Private tender.
tenderForm.errorSubmissionFutureDate: Submission date cannot be a future date.
tenderForm.errorExpiryRequired: Please enter the submission expiry date — required for a Private tender.
tenderForm.confirmSaveClosedTender: "{{name}}" is already marked {{stage}}. Are you sure you want to save changes to it?
tenderForm.errorGenericSave: Something went wrong saving this tender. Please try again.
tenderForm.confirmDelete: Delete the tender for "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
tenderForm.confirmRequalify: Re-qualify "{{name}}"? It will move back to New Lead and re-enter the pipeline from the top.
